a: Split data into train/validation/test to estimate generalization.
Overfit: great train, poor test. Underfit: poor on both.
k-fold cross-validation rotates validation folds for more robust estimates.
Confusion matrix counts TP/FP/TN/FN for classification performance.
F1 is the harmonic mean of precision and recall.
ROC AUC measures ranking quality of a binary classifier across thresholds.
Feature engineering creates informative inputs from raw data.
L1/L2 regularization penalizes large weights to reduce overfitting.
Batch size is how many samples per gradient update.
An epoch is one full pass over the training dataset.
Transfer learning reuses a pretrained model on a new related task.
